## Ranking submission checklist

- [ ] The submission is a new file at `community-rankings/submissions/<id>.json`.
- [ ] Every compared entry uses the same metric, unit, scope, and collection date.
- [ ] Sources are public HTTPS pages and each source has an access date.
- [ ] The methodology is reproducible and does not turn marketing copy into measured fact.
- [ ] My GitHub username, affiliation, and material conflicts are declared.
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, customer data, private analytics, or authenticated screenshots are included.
- [ ] I ran `python3 community_rankings.py` and committed the updated `COMMUNITY_RANKINGS.md`.
- [ ] I ran `python3 community_rankings.py --check` successfully.
